WITH rpt_contracts AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.title, src.company_id, src.company_name, src.deal_id, src.starts_at, src.ends_at, src.arr, src.billing_frequency, src.auto_renew, src.status, src.renew_deal_id, src.created_at FROM (
SELECT 
  ct.id,
  ct.organization_id,
  ct.title,
  ct.company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  ct.deal_id,
  ct.starts_at,
  ct.ends_at,
  COALESCE(ct.arr, 0) AS arr,
  ct.billing_frequency,
  ct.auto_renew,
  ct.status,
  ct.renew_deal_id,
  ct.created_at
FROM crm.contracts ct
LEFT JOIN crm.companies c ON c.id = ct.company_id AND c.organization_id = ct.organization_id
WHERE ct.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS evaluated_contracts, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'active' AND auto_renew = TRUE) AS BIGINT) AS retained_contracts, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST((CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'active' AND auto_renew = TRUE) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL)) * 100.0 AS DECIMAL), 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS retention_rate FROM rpt_contracts AS contracts WHERE TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE LIMIT 500
